label: Head to the Grey Road Inn

text.summary: Leave the incident site and look for witnesses at the inn.
text.full: The inn is the nearest place where survivors, travelers, or rumors might still be gathered.

recommendation.soft_suggestion: If the road is changing, the inn will have heard it first.

text.summary: Step away from the common room and speak with the shaken survivor.
text.full: The innkeeper points you toward the traveler sitting apart from the others.

text.summary: Step back into the inn proper.
text.full: The common room's low voices and watchful silence take over again.

text.summary: Take the road from the inn into the village.
text.full: If answers are going to matter, you will need the village as much as the road.

label: Return to the Grey Road Inn

text.summary: Go back to the inn and its travelers.
text.full: The inn remains the road-facing edge of Dunmere's fear.

text.summary: Leave Dunmere and follow the old path into the woods.
text.full: The old path is still passable, even if the village would rather pretend no one uses it anymore.

recommendation.soft_suggestion: The forest path is the clearest place to test the stories against the ground.

text.full: If the path is not enough, the people of Dunmere still have pieces you can test.

label: Follow the signs toward the shrine

text.summary: Track the movement patterns toward the ruined shrine.
text.full: The trail toward the shrine only makes sense once you know what to look for.

recommendation.soft_suggestion: The shrine is where the scattered movement finally begins to align.

text.summary: Back away from the ruined shrine and return to the forest path.
text.full: If the shrine is too dangerous for now, the path offers distance and time to think.

text.summary: Follow the deeper trail beneath the ruined shrine.
text.full: Only once the surface threat is broken and the hidden way is revealed can you safely descend.

recommendation.soft_suggestion: If you believe the shrine is not the end of the problem, the hollow is the only honest next step.

label: Climb back to the shrine ruins

text.full: The way back remains open, even if clarity does not.
